synopsis: Renee 生日晚宴上醉酒向 Susan 吐露一生的挚爱是 Tom（Lynette 的丈夫）；Gaby 设计让移民局抓走 Carmen 以挽留 Grace，但 Carmen 当晚带 Grace 逃往德州；Keith 准备向 Bree 求婚，被 Bree 临时邀来同席的 Keith 父亲 Richard 搅黄；Paul 用冤狱和解金买下紫藤巷 7 栋房产，欲开罪犯中途之家，遭 Lynette 牵头业委会反对；Tom 因 Lynette 从不在朋友面前夸他而大闹会议。

cards.meaning: 第三方托管资金（房产/法律交易中由中立方代管的钱）
cards.example: I had a lot of details to work out — the length of escrow, disclosure agreements.
cards.example_translation: 我还有很多细节要敲定——托管期、披露协议之类的。

cards.example: Make sure your lawyer discloses all material facts before signing.
cards.example_translation: 签之前确保你的律师把所有重要事实都披露出来。

cards.example: You'll still get your commission, even if the deal falls through.
cards.example_translation: 就算这笔交易告吹，你的佣金还是会照拿。

cards.example: I'm paying you well over market value, so stop hesitating.
cards.example_translation: 我付你的远高于市场价，别再犹豫了。

cards.example: He used his wrongful-incarceration settlement to buy seven houses on the lane.
cards.example_translation: 他用冤狱案拿到的和解金买下了这条街上的 7 栋房子。

cards.meaning: 冤枉的、不公正的（常用于 wrongful arrest / wrongful incarceration）
cards.example: After 8 years in prison, he won a wrongful incarceration lawsuit.
cards.example_translation: 蹲了 8 年监狱后，他打赢了这场冤狱官司。

cards.meaning: 中途之家（刑满或戒毒人员回归社会的过渡住所）
cards.example: He's planning to open a halfway house for felons on our street.
cards.example_translation: 他打算在我们这条街上开一个给重刑犯的中途之家。

cards.example: It's transitional housing for felons under house arrest.
cards.example_translation: 这是给软保释重刑犯的过渡性住所。

cards.example: I checked the bylaws — Paul can't open a halfway house without approval from the Association.
cards.example_translation: 我查过章程了——没业委会批准，Paul 没法开中途之家。

cards.example: The plan needs approval from at least 8 of the 14 homeowners.
cards.example_translation: 这个方案需要 14 户业主中至少 8 户同意。

cards.example: Since he only has one house, he only gets one vote — no way he gets a majority.
cards.example_translation: 他只有一栋房子，只能投一票——绝不可能拿到多数。

cards.example: She pretended she slipped in the bathroom and bumped her head.
cards.example_translation: 她假装自己在浴室滑倒撞到了头。

cards.example: She slipped in the bathroom and bumped her head on the tile.
cards.example_translation: 她在浴室滑倒，头撞到了瓷砖。

cards.example: Just when I think you can't find new ways to embarrass me, you top yourself.
cards.example_translation: 我以为你已经不可能再让我丢脸了，你又刷新了记录。

cards.example: Let's say, hypothetically, I know a woman who's in this country illegally.
cards.example_translation: 比如说吧，假设我认识一个在本国非法居留的女士。

cards.example: Calling immigration on her would make her stay here illegal.
cards.example_translation: 举报她让她在这里的居留变成非法的。

cards.example: If she stays here, she'll become a spoiled girl who never thinks of others.
cards.example_translation: 如果她留在这里，会变成一个只顾自己的娇惯女孩。

cards.meaning: 有天赋的；（俚）身材出众的
cards.example: I'm not trying to be crass, but Tom is quite gifted in that department.
cards.example_translation: 我不是故意冒犯，但 Tom 那方面真的天赋异禀。

cards.example: He figures out a way to sneak back into the country.
cards.example_translation: 他想办法偷偷溜回国。

cards.example: A halfway house for convicts on our street? Are you insane?
cards.example_translation: 一条街的罪犯中途之家？你疯了吗？
